svg.title: FileSquid v2 mockup 40: Host indicator and privacy statement
svg.desc: Host indicator in the app header (owner decision 1a): a badge with a device icon and the host label "This device" replaces the former privacy sentence, in the same place on every browsing screen. Opening it shows a popover with the ADR 032 desktop statement "Your files stay on this device. Only you can read them." and a link to Settings, Privacy. After the MVP, when backup or sync is on, the popover adds "Backup copies are encrypted on this device before upload." Light and dark, keyboard focus shown.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The header badge names the host. Opening it, by click or keyboard, states who can read the files.

svg.text: The badge is a button. Enter, Space or a click opens the popover; Esc or a click outside closes it and returns focus to the badge.

svg.text: The same statement appears in Settings, Privacy (mockup 32). The badge label comes from the host: "This device" on the desktop.
